note: Both sets share the same core claims (3/8" through bolt, Module A/B total lengths 12'-3 3/4" and 10'-3 3/4", L3X3X1/4 profiles, and the 5/16" bolt callout), and both carry the same vague 'PV Detail | dimension' entries. Set A additionally captures the L3X3X1/4 member profile shown in the Module B detail, which Set B omits. Set A's only defect is a redundant second 'Through Bolt | diameter | 3/8"' claim that misuses the S-301 reference tag as a condition. On balance A carries one more supported, correctly bound claim than B.
